title: Seven Societal Benefits of K‑Field Discoveries

benefits.text: It unites cosmic structure and sub‑atomic constants, giving physics a single geometric backbone.
Its seven‑sheet registry offers a controllable route to field‑based propulsion and inertia management.
Precise spacings map directly to lattice‑matched materials, unlocking a new class of resonant energy and sensor devices.
Its directional gravity envelope enables high‑accuracy navigation, timing, and geodesy without satellite networks.
Mirror‑equivalence transforms hint at room‑temperature entanglement channels for ultra‑secure communication and computation.
The reciprocal‑metric hierarchy provides a blueprint for scaling fundamental interactions, guiding everything from particle design to fusion confinement.
By tying natural constants to geometry, it offers an immediate cross‑check on experimental anomalies, accelerating discovery while reducing costly trial‑and‑error.
